subject: Access implementation playlist & prework — NetSecure onboarding
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@netsecure.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: NetSecure onboarding: initial access playbook and prework

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the intro. We're scoped to start the NetSecure onboarding the week of May 3. Per our internal checklist we need a short, prioritized playbook for the access controls workstream (SSO/SAML, SCIM attribute mapping, IP allowlists, service accounts, org policies). Can you send a suggested implementation cadence and a short prework list we can share with our infra and security teams?

High-level constraints from our side:
- Production tenants sit in our us-west-2 VPC; outbound egress is NAT'd and tightly controlled.
- We use on-prem IdP (Okta in hybrid mode) and a separate provisioning pipeline for service accounts.
- Procurement requires SOC2 evidence for any data-plane integrations before cutover.

If helpful, I'll attach our internal mapping template (we can share it). Would love a 20–30 minute call next week to sync.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Kim
Director, Platform Security
NetSecure Inc.
[Attachment: netsecure-mapping-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@netsecure.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NetSecure onboarding: initial access playbook and prework

Thanks Alice — great context. We're excited to get this moving. Below is a condensed 'implementation playlist' geared to your constraints; I attached a lightweight prework checklist that maps to each item.

Proposed 4-week cadence (recommended):
1) Week 0 — Prework + discovery (IDP metadata, SCIM user/org attributes, IP egress profile).
   - Deliverable: completed mapping template (your spreadsheet) + list of egress IP ranges.
2) Week 1 — SAML integration & SSO smoke tests in staging.
   - Deliverable: IdP metadata exchange (entityID, ACS URL), signed certificate thumbprint.
3) Week 2 — SCIM provisioning proof-of-concept and attribute reconciliation.
   - Deliverable: SCIM token, attribute map, sample user sync.
4) Week 3 — Service accounts + org policy alignment, dry-run cutover in staging.
   - Deliverable: service account matrix, least-privilege policies, test cutover plan.
5) Post-cutover — Observability and rollback/runbook handoff.

Gating points we recommend: SAML smoke green, SCIM sync of critical attributes (email, external_id, groups), and IP egress confirmation for dedicated egress ranges. If procurement needs SOC2 evidence early, we'll share our compliance pack (link below).

Attachments: prework-checklist.pdf, sample-saml-snippet.txt

Call windows: I'm free Tue/Wed next week 10–12 PT. Ben — would you and Monica join for the technical sync?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Calendly: https://cal.com/tessa-morgan/30]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@netsecure.io>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NetSecure onboarding: initial access playbook and prework

Hi Alice / Tessa — adding a few technical notes from the implementation side so your infra team can triage before the sync:

SAML / SSO
- Preferred: SP-initiated with signed assertions; entityID should be your IdP's production URI.
- We can accept either a PEM cert or an RSA fingerprint for signing.
- We'll provide a minimal saml-config-snippets.txt showing ACS/Logout URLs for staging and prod.

SCIM
- SCIM v2 with Bearer token auth; common attributes we map: userName, externalId, emails[0].value, active, groups.
- Please populate the attached scim-attribute-map.csv with your attribute names and example values.

Service accounts / org policies
- Create service accounts for: provisioning (scim-bot), monitoring (obs-ingest), and cutover (canary-runner).
- Prefer short-lived tokens if your pipeline supports token exchange; otherwise record rotation cadence.

IP allowlist & egress
- We need the exact CIDR ranges for outbound NAT to permit callbacks. If you cannot share ranges publicly, one approach is to whitelist our staging egress hostnames for validation first and then provide CIDRs for prod.

I'll attach the snippets and maps here. We'll also include a short 'cutover safety checklist' that our operations team will use during the staging dry run.

monica.p
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Implementation | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: saml-config-snippets.txt] [Attachment: scim-attribute-map.csv]

Thanks — that playlist looks straightforward. A couple of operational notes from our network team:

- We cannot share full egress CIDR blocks in the first call; procurement insists on a scoped IP egress policy document (attached). We can provide exact ranges in-week-of-cutover or via an NDA'd channel.
- Procurement will want SOC2 evidence before production cutover. Can you point me to the compliance pack? (Alice forwarded the drive link previously.)
- Also: for SCIM, our provisioning pipeline enforces externalId uniqueness across orgs; please confirm Redwood's behavior when duplicates are detected (fail vs. reconcile).

I'll accept the Tue 10:30 PT slot — please pencil me in. Once we confirm the prework owners below, we'll distribute to our infra/security teams:
Prework owners
- IdP metadata & certs: Alice Kim
- SCIM attribute map: Sam Irving (provisioning)

Forwarding the initial mapping template (internal) for your reference.

Best,
Sam Irving
Platform Engineer | NetSecure Inc.
